Entity.description: Fields that every entity of the model has: an identifier, audit instants and the extensions object. An entity is a class whose records exist on their own and that other data can refer to. A value class, such as PersonName or DateInterval, exists only inlined in an entity, so it has no identifier and no audit instants. Departs from Apache OFBiz (DMO-006): each entity has its own UUID key, never a key of several fields. DMO-021, DMO-022, DMO-050, DMO-053.

Extensions.description: The extensions object. Each member is named after the ISO 3166-1 or ISO 3166-2 code of one jurisdiction, in lowerCamelCase, such as ca or caQc. A jurisdiction with no such code nests its member in the member of the nearest coded jurisdiction, such as caQc.montreal. Its value is an object that the profile of that jurisdiction defines. The core model accepts any member, so that a system can keep extensions it does not know. The generated SHACL shape of this class is left open after generation, as model/test-model.sh records. DMO-053, DMO-056.
